backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining an Inquiry type and two public functions: submitInquiry (stores name, company, email, message, and timestamp) and getAllInquiries (returns all stored inquiries as an array).
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping completed feature IDs to their titles, affected files, component dependencies, and test IDs, covering company name rebranding to 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd' and the hero section video background replacement.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's component structure, styling, and routing setup.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, covering background, foreground, primary, secondary, border, chart, and sidebar color variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with SEO metadata (title, description, keywords), Open Graph and Twitter Card tags, and a JSON-LD Organization structured data block, all branded as 'Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React application that sets up ModalContext with open/close/isOpen state, a TanStack QueryClient, and a TanStack Router with a Layout root route (Navigation, Outlet, Footer, InquiryModal) and two child routes for Home and AnnualProgram.
frontend/src/components/annual/FAQSectio: An accordion-based FAQ section for the annual program page, displaying six predefined questions and answers about Nexiris verification services.
frontend/src/components/annual/PricingSe: A pricing section for the annual program page showing two plan cards (Single Report at $649 and Annual Program at $5,499) with feature lists and enquiry buttons.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Dark-themed institutional footer displaying the Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd logo, services navigation links with smooth-scroll, contact details (email and address), an enquire button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/home/AnnualProgr: A home-page pricing section displaying Single Report and Annual Program plan cards with feature lists and scroll-triggered animations.
frontend/src/components/home/Credibility: A stats section displaying animated count-up numbers (15+ years, 2400+ verifications, 100% independent) with a scroll-triggered trigger and a supporting quote.
frontend/src/components/home/FinalCTASec: A full-width call-to-action section with a headline, subtext, and two buttons for scheduling a consultation or contacting via email.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: Full-screen hero section with video background, animated headline, CTA buttons for enquiry and services, and a stats row; fades in on mount.
frontend/src/components/home/HowItWorksS: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/home/ProblemSect: Section displaying three risk cards (Counterparty Risk, Regulatory Exposure, Documentation Failures) with scroll-triggered animations using the useScrollAnimation hook.
frontend/src/components/home/TradeScoreS: Section showcasing the proprietary Trade Trust Score™ with an SVG radar chart and five scored dimensions rendered as progress bars, animated on scroll.
frontend/src/components/home/WhatWeDeliv: Section listing eight deliverables of the verification report (entity verification, compliance screening, etc.) in a two-column checklist layout with scroll animations.
frontend/src/components/InquiryModal.tsx: A modal dialog component for submitting consultation inquiries, with form validation, error handling, and a success confirmation state after submission.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: A fixed top navigation bar with scroll-aware styling, smooth-scroll section links, mobile menu toggle, and an enquiry modal trigger.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) via React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountUp.ts: Custom hook that animates a number from a start to end value over a given duration using requestAnimationFrame with an ease-out cubic curve, respecting prefers-reduced-motion.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY Internet Identity authentication state, including login, logout, and identity persistence via AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports a useSubmitInquiry mutation hook that calls the backend actor's submitInquiry method and invalidates the inquiries query cache on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollAnimation.ts: Custom React hook that uses IntersectionObserver to return a ref and an `isVisible` boolean that triggers when the element enters the viewport, with immediate visibility for users who prefer reduced motion.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts (Montserrat, Inter), defining Tailwind base/component/utility layers, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using oklch colors, gradient utilities, and scroll animation keyframes/classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the app with QueryClientProvider (React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AnnualProgram.tsx: Annual Program page that renders the PricingSection and FAQSection components, passing the global modal opener to the pricing section for enquiry CTAs.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes all homepage sections (Hero, Problem, WhatWeDeliver, TradeScore, AnnualProgram, Credibility, FinalCTA) and passes the enquiry modal opener to relevant sections.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom brand colors (mintyBlue palette), Montserrat/Inter font families, oklch-based semantic color tokens, custom box shadows, border radii, and accordion keyframe animations.
project_state.json: Project state snapshot (version 13) documenting the site's architecture, design decisions, known issues, and feature history for the Nexiris Global Pvt Ltd institutional advisory website with a two-page structure and Frost White + Minty Blue brand palette.
